draftInvitation.tagline: Fast & One-derful! The  First  and Furious Birthday Celebration!
draftInvitation.welcomeMessage: Get ready to race into a day full of giggles,  and unforgettable memories as our little champion Eros crosses the finish line into year ONE!
draftInvitation.venueName: Jollibee Banawe (In front of Philippine Orthopedic Center)
draftInvitation.venueAddress: Banawe St. (In front of Philippine Orthopedic Center), Santa Mesa Heights, Quezon City, Metro Manila
draftInvitation.reminders:
• Complimentary parking available at Jollibee Banawe.
• Jollibee & Friends party games and special mascot show!
• Official Cake Ceremony & Birthday Song begins at 7 PM sharp!
• Delicious Chickenjoy, Jolly Spaghetti, and party treats for all guests!
draftInvitation.closingMessage: Thank you for being part of Eros' extraordinary first year! Your love and presence mean the world to us.
draftInvitation.closingSignOff: See you at the starting line! — The Family

schedule.title: Pit Lane Arrival & Check-In
schedule.description: Guests arrive, grab party hats, personalized racing lanyards and pit crew refreshments.

schedule.title: Grand Prix Party Games & Jollibee Mascot Show
schedule.description: Fun-filled party games, dancing, and high-energy celebration with Jollibee!

schedule.title: Champion Cake Ceremony & Birthday Song
schedule.description: Singing Happy Birthday and blowing the candle for our little champion Eros!

schedule.title: Winner's Feast (Chickenjoy & Treats)
schedule.description: Crispy Chickenjoy, Jolly Spaghetti, Peach Mango Pies, and celebration drinks.

schedule.title: Victory Podium Photo Ops & Favors
schedule.description: Commemorative photos with Eros, checkered flags, and party loot bags.

milestones.lovesTo: Clap hands when hearing music & wave flags
milestones.superpower: Speed crawling across the room in 3 seconds flat!

theme.marqueeText: 🏁 EROS TURNS ONE 🏎️ GRAND PRIX CELEBRATION 🏁 JOLLIBEE BANAWE (IN FRONT OF PHILIPPINE ORTHOPEDIC CENTER) 🏎️ VIP PIT PASS ONLY 🏁
theme.envelopeTagline: To celebrate Eros' 1st Birthday Grand Prix!

rsvpSettings.customConfirmationMessage: Vroom vroom! Your pit pass is confirmed for Eros' 1st Birthday. See you at Jollibee Banawe!

wishes.message: Happy 1st Birthday baby Eros! Vroom to the moon!

faqs.question: What is the dress code for the party?
faqs.answer: Gray, White, Red except blue. Please dress in these racing colors to join in the photo motif!

faqs.question: Where is the venue located?
faqs.answer: Jollibee Banawe, located directly in front of the Philippine Orthopedic Center on Banawe St., Quezon City.

faqs.question: Is there parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary parking is available at the Jollibee Banawe parking slots and nearby streets.

faqs.question: What time will the mascot show start?
faqs.answer: The games and Jollibee mascot appearance will begin promptly around 7:30 PM!
